Variants.Content: Recognition comes from protection and shared risk. A title cannot levy hungry households indefinitely; relief and returned captives sustain trust.

Settlement protection and shared risk support Perbund. Military recognition also rests on rewards and relief; a title needs willing action. Relief and returned captives sustain trust more than titles.
